subject: fix hardcoded db_num in metadata_manager.cc (#1259)
reason: The fix is inside coordinator::MetadataManager::OnLoadingEnded, which only exists when valkey-search is started in cluster mode with the --use-coordinator module argument (valkey_search.cc:1185 creates the MetadataManager only under GetUseCoordinator() && IsCluster()). That option can only be enabled as a module command-line argument: it is built Hidden() (valkey_search_options.cc:144) and ModuleConfigManager::Init skips hidden entries (vmsdk module_config.cc:126), so it is never registered with Valkey and no server_config line or CONFIG SET can turn it on. The fuzzer loads modules by bare pat
